title: Rav Anan bar Tachlifa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was a student of Shmuel, as we find that he said: "Many times I stood before Shmuel" (Pesachim 101; Ketubot 61), and he said: "It was explained to me by Master Shmuel himself" (Moed Katan 18b).
And we find in Sanhedrin 96b: Rav Anan bar Tachlifa sent to Rav Yosef — it should read Rav Chanan, according to the version of Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied Pesachim 101 and Ketubot 61 locators have commas, not period or colon side marks; the translation therefore leaves their sides unspecified.

Moed Katan and Dikdukei Soferim expand כמו״ק and דק״ס contextually. The Chanan reading in Sanhedrin is Hyman’s proposed correction, so that occurrence is not silently assigned to Anan. The earlier draft’s addition of amud a to the two comma-marked citations is not adopted.
